finding: One damage call runs in fixed order: blood or puff at the hit point, knockback (damage x scale / mass, applied even to an immune target), immunity gate, armour, health, flash, death, flinch roll, threat lock (p_inter.c 765-911; p_map.c 1008-1011).

Per-kind flinch dice: the pain state fires when a 0-255 roll is below the kind's painchance. The player's roll is near-always and the donor's heaviest kind is near-never, so heavy foes read as heavy with no extra state. Best transferable idea: put a poise roll on the same call as the damage.
Pain voice is the action of the second pain frame, about four ticks after the hit. A missed roll means no flinch and no sound, so a landed hit can be silent (info.c 292-293; p_enemy.c 1579-1580).
Screen flash: counter += damage, capped at 100, drains one point per tick in life. Tint band is ceiling(counter/8), capped at seven steps (p_inter.c 875-877; p_user.c 356; st_stuff.c 1008-1023).
Blood in three sizes by raw damage, with an upward push and 0-3 ticks of random life cut. Spawned before the damage call so the visual leads the health change (p_mobj.c 849-858; p_map.c 1005-1011).

Defect, ouch face sign inverted: st_stuff.c tests health minus last tick's health (807, 860, 994), so the big-hit face cannot fire on damage. Fix: last tick minus now, keep the idea. Sketch bigHitDrop.
Defect, rumble is a stub: p_inter.c 883 calls I_Tactile but i_system.c 55-61 does nothing. Fix: implement a client vibrate on heavy hits (phone haptics untested on iOS) or drop the call.
Absent in the half read: no hit stop and no screen shake in p_*.c, st_stuff.c, i_video.c. Only the flash, knockback and the blood push are present.

Death presentation: the player's camera drops toward a low height and turns toward the killer 5 degrees per tick (p_user.c 182-215); a kill below minus the kind's spawn health picks the gib state (p_inter.c 719-722).

Threat lock: a victim with no lock takes the hitter as target and locks for 100 ticks (p_inter.c 910-911; BASETHRESHOLD in p_local.h). This is the donor's answer to several attackers; maps to the row 4 hate list.

Shotgun volley: each body pellet adds to the blood count and to one victim's damage total; wall pellets add to the puff count. One damage call per victim, then one blood and one gunshot record at the last hit point (qw-qc/weapons.qc 257-315). Best transferable idea: merge hits per victim before presenting.

Client damage record merges every hit to a client within a frame, from any attacker, but keeps only the last attacker's position (combat.qc 173-178; WinQuake/sv_main.c 589-594). Keep the merge, fix the direction (sum or list of hitters).

Screen flash: +3 per count, count = about half the raw hit with a floor of 10, capped at 150, drains 150 per second. Tint is pale, mid or full red by armour versus health (WinQuake/view.c 316-378, 557).

Directional kick: roll = count x side x cvar, pitch = count x forward x cvar, timer decays and the kick follows timer over kick-time (view.c 373-378, 815-819). Cvar defaults not read. Kick points at the attacker, readable at 375 wide.
Pain voice: one of six clips, at most one per 0.5 s per player (player.qc 317-335). Flinch frame skipped while the weapon frame is busy, so a committed swing finishes (player.qc 369-371).

Defect, blood count ignores damage: SpawnBlood writes a constant 1 (qw-qc/weapons.qc 151-155), so the laser's call with 15 (misc.qc 344) makes 20 particles regardless. Fix: scale the count from damage or drop the parameter.
Defect, dead spray code: TraceAttack computes a spray velocity (weapons.qc 264-266) and never uses it. Fix: aim the spray with it or delete the two lines.
Death: a player below minus 40 health is gibbed (head and three gibs) with velocity from the damage (player.qc 624-626).
Absent in the half read: no hit stop. The pausetime fields (client.qc 958, server.qc 94) are not a hit freeze. Our hit freeze would be new, not a donor idea.
